# Device payload fixtures

- Tilt Pi form fields and measurement values are from the [Tilt Cloud Logging API example](https://github.com/baronbrew/TILTpi#tilt-cloud-logging-api).
- GravityMon's JSON format and temperature and corrected-gravity values are from its [data formats guide](https://mp-se.github.io/gravitymon/v1.4/data.html).
- The RAPT measurements were transcribed from a [captured Pill telemetry report](https://www.merewether.com/blog/node-red-flow-to-take-rapt-webhook-and-push-to-mqtt), omitting identifiers.
- The iSpindel readings come from a [posted firmware capture](https://homebrewtalk.com/threads/ispindle-diy-electronic-hydrometer.598187/page-61). Names, credentials and device identifiers are omitted or replaced.
- The TiltBridge fixture represents its custom-stream payload.
